description: This file implements concurrency debugging utilities, including tracking mutex contention times and logging stack traces when contention exceeds thresholds. It is part of the experimental concurrency debugging features in the starboard namespace.

classes.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker
classes.description: A RAII class that tracks mutex acquisition attempts and logs contention details if contention exceeds thresholds.

methods.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker::ScopedMutexWaitTracker
methods.description: Constructor that attempts to acquire a mutex and records start time if not immediately acquired.

methods.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker::~ScopedMutexWaitTracker
methods.description: Destructor that calculates wait time, updates maximum contention, and logs details if contention is significant.
